summary: Frontend-only testing of Upcoming Events home section + Gallery page split. All 8 acceptance criteria pass. Home shows the Upcoming Events section with festival poster (loads OK, 1122x1402), FESTIVAL badge, date/venue caption ('27.09.2026 • DUPLEX Prague') and 'Get Tickets →' CTA. Clicking the poster navigates to /tickets. Home no longer contains map-section/map-image. /gallery renders Navbar + 'The Map' section with floorplan.png (HTTP 200, ~2.2MB) + Footer. Desktop nav Gallery/Events/Contact links work; mobile hamburger opens dropdown, mobile Gallery link navigates and closes menu. Footer Gallery quick link navigates to /gallery. Lockdown gate shows in fresh context and unlocking with the .env password grants access.

issues: floorplan.png is served as a ~2.2MB PNG. It renders fine but consider compressing/converting to WebP for faster load, especially on mobile.

critical_code_review_comments: Landing.js UpcomingEvents: poster uses fixed max-w-sm on desktop which keeps the card small and left-aligned as intended per reference — matches spec.
GalleryPage.js: floorplan image is ~2.2MB; add loading='lazy' or serve a compressed/WebP version for perf.
Consider adding an alt/skeleton state while the large floorplan image loads.
test_credentials: Lockdown password: read from /app/backend/.env (LOCKDOWN_PASSWORD). Successfully verified unlock works.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All navigation, section presence, image loads, mobile menu, footer link, and lockdown gate flows verified end-to-end on the preview URL. Only optional perf note: /assets/floorplan.png is 2.2MB.
